about: Real brush and pen strokes cut from open-access museum images (CC0 / public domain), for exemplar-based stroke synthesis (warp an exemplar along a new path, after RealBrush, Lu et al. 2013). Each stroke: an RGBA WebP (paint colour unmixed from its ground, ground transparent), its centerline from the loaded end (start) to the lift (polyline, crop px), the half-width at 32 even steps along it (crop px), mean colour, length (crop px). scale = crop px per source px; origin = the crop's top-left in source px. split = cut out of a joined character at a junction (one end may be a cut, not a tip). Built by tools/strokes/.
